newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany tightens borders against Albania refugees.
newsitem.headline: Germany tightens borders against Albania refugees.

text.p: German Interior Minister Manfred Kanther ordered border guards to step up security on Germany's borders to prevent an influx of refugees from Albania, his ministry said on Wednesday.

The order coincided with Italy's decision to impose emergency measures to cope with a flood of Albanian refugees. Italian Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini cautioned that the exodus, which has brought more than 10,000 Albanians across the Adriatic Sea since March 13, posed a threat to all of Europe.
Kanther said Germany had already taken on a great burden by taking in 320,000 Bosnians who fled their nation's civil war, as well as what he described as hundreds of thousands of asylum seekers.
"It is not possible...to cope with a further wave of refugees," Kanther was quoted as saying in a ministry statement.
He said Albanians trying to escape the turmoil in their Balkan homeland would have no right to asylum under German law because they were not escaping political persecution.
"Peace and security must be restored in Albania to stem the flow of refugees leaving the country," Kanther said.
Although there were no signs large numbers of Albanians were heading for Germany, border guards should nonetheless be prepared in case this were to happen, he added.
